primary_actual_evidence.actual_scope: Three direct original frequency_shared parent updates followed by one disabled delegation, same initial state, native64 batch, seed and original Adam/AMP configuration.
primary_actual_evidence.interpretation: The unchanged direct parent itself reproduces the old failing updated-parameter gate before disabled graph delegation. Raw gradient plus coupled weight decay nearly cancel, leaving an effective gradient below Adam epsilon. The measured moments and group reconstruct the actual parameter delta with the listed residual; raw-gradient-plus-decay values agree with moment-derived values to ordinary FP32 arithmetic precision. This supports Adam sensitivity as the amplification mechanism at this element. It does not identify the upstream source or CUDA kernel responsible for the tiny raw-gradient variation.
